commands.text: The worm refines essence by a small stage while it is fed, and it is fed on wine, which costs stones, which I do not have. The cultivation is free. The appetite is not.
The Liquor worm stops refining Rank two essence. Recorded, not played.
Confirmed what I remembered: it will not raise Rank two essence. Whatever advantage this gives me has a ceiling, and the ceiling arrives before the danger does. Plan accordingly.
